name: 07026 · Garfield, NJ
findings: ZIP 07026 (Garfield) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07026 (Garfield) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07026 (Garfield) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 38% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
